references.name: Trust for Public Land ParkServe
references.role: National coverage benchmark and candidate-gap reference
references.coverage: Park data for more than 15,000 United States cities and towns, with park polygons and selected trail and playground layers
references.usageRule: Use the published aggregate count as a planning denominator and ParkServe records to identify questions for official-source reconciliation. Do not copy, redistribute, modify, or publicly display the bulk dataset unless a maintainer documents permission and the applicable upstream licenses. Verify every publishable AuditMap record with its operator or another allowed authoritative source.
